annotations.title: Apply a proposal in the ad account

description: Use this only after the user has seen a specific proposal and said to apply it. Not for changes the user describes without a proposal. Makes the change a proposal the user has seen and approved describes, in the live ad account: pauses the campaign, ad group or keyword, or moves its bid or daily budget by the proposed step (at most 20%). Apple Ads, Meta and Google Ads (Meta and Google Ads move budgets and pause; they have no bids to move). Apptiller first reads the entity live from the platform and writes only if it still has the value the proposal started from; the value it replaces is kept, so the change can be undone. A proposal waits while an earlier change to the same entity, one above it or one inside it is still being measured (7 days), so what each change did can be told apart. This spends or saves real money.
